states.meaning: A verified identity or fresh ticket is required.
The transport is open and waiting for gateway.ready plus compatibility evidence.
The transport and selected surface are usable.
Server-owned session history and status are being resolved.
The old transport ended and recovery is in progress.
A prompt may have reached the server, but its result is unknown.
Required compatibility evidence or behavior is absent or mismatched.
A known connection or restoration attempt failed.
The transport is closing and cleanup is in progress.

cases.notes: Offline is safe and has no transport side effect.
Authentication is required before a connection can open.
Gateway readiness and both compatibility gates precede selected-session restoration.
Application methods cannot cross the gateway.ready barrier.
Passing evidence without gateway.ready does not enable the connection.
A missing gateway.ready deadline closes the transport and reports a semantic handshake failure.
A missing or mismatched attestation blocks the surface.
A failed behavioral probe blocks the surface.
Ready is observable only after the compatibility gate has passed.
A selected/active profile mismatch is rejected before a ready context can exist.
A profile that drifts before transport readiness cannot reach ready.
Restoration resolves the selected server-owned session.
An empty restore result returns to ready without inventing a session.
Restoring is a barrier and does not permit prompt retry.
Reconnecting keeps local safe state while a new transport is pending.
A known failure remains recoverable only through explicit user action.
Incompatibility is terminal for this surface and has no fallback.
Reconnect uses a new ticket and restores before recovery actions while preserving the configured profile.
Reconnect and restore reject an active profile that drifts from the selected configured profile.
A reconnect cannot reuse the old upgrade credential.
A reused or consumed ticket enters authentication recovery.
Restore rejects profile drift while preserving the selected configured profile.
History retry is blocked until restore completes.
History is the only kind of retry represented after restore.
Prompt submission is not an idempotent retry.
A lost result enters delivery_uncertain and preserves the draft.
C-05 stops after restore and defers resend choice to C-06.
The connection contract never auto-resubmits an uncertain prompt.
Cancellation closes cleanup and suppresses reconnect.
Restore cancellation preserves safe local state.
Reconnect cancellation never schedules another reconnect.
Sign-out clears the selected server session but preserves the draft.
Closing completes cleanup and does not reconnect.
Authentication rejection invalidates the connection path.
Known host or origin rejection is incompatible for this surface.
A disabled embedded chat surface is incompatible.
A known peer rejection is a failed connection outcome.
A superseded attachment is a failed operation, not an unknown close.
A PTY exit is a known failed outcome; this fixture does not reconnect Terminal.
A known backend failure is recoverable only by explicit retry.
Unknown events cannot become interactive behavior.
Unknown close codes cannot trigger an unsafe fallback.
Authentication recovery mints a fresh ticket before opening the transport.
A network loss returns to offline without claiming rejection.
Prompt send before handshake readiness is blocked.
Selected session and draft remain local during explicit reconnect cancellation.
Sign-out is safe even while prompt delivery remains uncertain.
